name: Gusto
summary: Payroll and people platform for small and medium-sized businesses.
overview: Gusto delivers payroll, benefits, and HR software to smaller businesses.
bull_case: Payroll is sticky and offers a foundation for broader financial and HR services.
bear_case: SMB churn, incumbents, and lower employment growth can weigh on expansion.

intelligence.description: Gusto provides payroll, benefits, HR, and compliance software for small and medium-sized businesses.
company: Gusto sells a software platform for payroll, benefits, and HR administration to small and medium-sized businesses.
Payroll is a recurring workflow with high switching costs, giving the company a route to expand through benefits and financial services.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Gusto is a bellwether for the economics of software-led payroll serving small businesses, a market shaped by employment growth, churn, and financial-services attachment.

changed.text: Raised $175M Series E; subsequent valuation information is not confirmed in primary public disclosure.

takeaways: Payroll is a sticky entry point into SMB financial workflows.
Benefits and HR products drive the expansion opportunity.
A current priced valuation is not publicly confirmed.
